title: Composition of Gaussian noise operators
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho,\sigma\in[-1,1]$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be integrable and strongly measurable under the product standard Gaussian measure. Applying the Gaussian noise operator at parameter $\sigma$ and then at parameter $\rho$ agrees almost everywhere, under that measure, with applying it once at parameter $\rho\sigma$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is integrable under the product standard Gaussian measure
$f$ is strongly measurable under the product standard Gaussian measure
